Field Notes: Tidal Marshes

Salt marshes sit between land and sea. They slow waves, hold sediment, and create sheltered habitat for fish and migrating birds.

A useful field survey records water level, plant cover, and visible erosion at the same marked locations throughout the season.

What to bring

  • A notebook with waterproof pages
  • A current survey map
Observe first; disturb as little as possible.
